frame: x east, z south, metres from the place anchor in the MapLibre Mercator frame
selection: ways classified as context (steps, paths, roads, city walls, retaining walls, cemeteries, gate buildings, buildings and building parts, woods, orchards and grass) and mapped single trees with any vertex within 450 m of (0, 0); plus the monument outlines or corner nodes used for registration

registration.method: Not registered: no mapped outline can be tied to a model point, so the model stays at the place anchor with the anchor's precision.
